data.metaDescription: Dex is AI with full operational memory across your entire workspace. Every datapoint is ingested, synced, and structured into compounding context for high-leverage work.
data.text: Product Use Cases Pricing Blog Join Dex The self-driving workspace for operators. Dex is AI with full operational memory across your entire workspace. Every datapoint is ingested, synced, and structured into compounding context for high-leverage work. Join Dex Install Dex, then book your onboarding call. Browser-first. Where all your work already lives. Chrome iMessage Slack Desktop SOON Dex captures the operational reality of your workspace. Then it turns that context into action. How it Works The graph holds the record. The manual holds the judgment. Operational Graph The full organizational record across your operations. Every message, meeting, deal update, and workflow event — organized into entities, relationships, timelines, and dependencies. A living source of truth of how work connects and changes over time. Knowledge Manual The evolving understanding of what currently matters. Your priorities, open loops, relationship context, SOPs, and operating principles — captured as you work, updated as things change. Explicitly editable, automatically maintained. This is where judgment lives. Autonomous Agents Create automatic agents to orchestrate across Gmail, Slack, CRM, and 20+ tools—triggered by events or schedules. Browser Control Dex acts directly in your browser to navigate tabs, fill forms, and complete work where the context already lives. Bring Your Context Anywhere Use Dex's SDK and MCP to bring your operational context into any agent, tool, or workflow. Across your favorite apps Dex connects with power apps, acting across tabs to eliminate context switching. Proactive. Self-improving. Always on. Dex learns from your corrections, approvals, edits, and repeated patterns. The more you use it, the sharper it gets. ALWAYS RUNNING Dreamer Agent Reasons 24/7 over new data. Maintains your knowledge base, spots emerging patterns, keeps your operational context current — even when you're away. WEEKLY OUTPUT Skill Builder Agent Generates custom automations and skill suggestions each week, tailored to your repeated workflows to continuously optimize your setup. Bigger than agent memory.Retrieval surfaces facts. Execution requires reasoning across past precedent, relationships, and context to inform judgment in the next moment. Your second brain. For work that used to slip through the cracks. Meeting prep with full context Before every meeting, Dex pulls your full history — emails, past calls, open commitments. Afterwards, automatically send follow-ups using call notes, and writing tone. Task triage that learns your priorities CRM updates without the data entry Dex is changing how high-leverage teams work. “For the first time, my agents actually understand the deal. Not just the CRM fields — the history, the stakeholders, the nuance. Dex gave them operational clarity I didn’t think was possible.” P Partner Mid-market PE firm “I stopped scrambling before every call. Now I simply open Dex at the side and never forget to follow up after. That alone is worth it.” F Founder B2B SaaS · Series A “Dex is what I was trying to build manually with Notion and n8n for years. It just works — and it gets better every week.” H Head of BD Growth-stage startup “Dex is my go-to tool for immediate in-browser intelligence. A delightful product from a user-obsessed team :)” V VC Theory Ventures “Dex has been a game changing tool for me to build workflows and automations, quickly, and easily within Chrome. As someone who has dabbled with numerous tools, I can confidently say Dex’s user experience (and customer support!), is incredible.” C CEO Series B “Not in your way, but always helpful. Has helped me in countless ways I can’t even imagine. Invisibly fit into my life and couldn’t be more happier. A web agent that can actually do things.” F Founder “Compared favorably to Strawberry AI and other tools. Uses it to eliminate busy work instead of hiring an EA.” F Former CEO Series B “The meeting prep alone saved me 5 hours a week. But the real magic is how it connects dots across tools I didn’t even realize were related.” C COO Series B fintech “Built automated LinkedIn → Google Sheets CRM workflow processing 275+ DM conversations.” P Power User Trusted by operators at Google, OpenAI, Goldman Sachs, Salesforce, Palantir, Meta and 10,000+ more Own your intelligence. Every interaction compounds into an asset that belongs to you alone. Talk to us about private cloud → See Privacy Policy 256-bit Encryption All data encrypted at rest and in transit. Enterprise-grade security across every layer of the stack. Private Cloud Available Deploy Dex on your own infrastructure. Full data isolation for teams that need it. Multi-factor Auth MFA enforced across all accounts. Granular permissions for every tool, data source, and integration. Full Data Control You own everything. Export, delete, or disconnect anytime. Browser memory is off by default. Get Started with Dex We’re onboarding operators who run multiple deals, work across multiple tools, and need their context to compound.
